SUMMARIZE_SOURCES.label: Summarize Sources
SUMMARIZE_SOURCES.instruction: Summarize the selected sources using only what is present in the source-derived content below. Do not introduce facts that are not present or implied by the sources. Mark anything uncertain as UNKNOWN.

COMPARE_ARCHITECTURES.label: Compare Architectures
COMPARE_ARCHITECTURES.instruction: Compare the architectural approaches described across the selected sources. Identify agreements, disagreements, and gaps. Do not invent an architecture that is not evidenced in the sources.

EXTRACT_MECHANISMS.label: Extract Mechanisms
EXTRACT_MECHANISMS.instruction: Extract the concrete mechanisms, algorithms, or procedures described in the selected sources. List each mechanism with the source ID it came from.

IDENTIFY_CONTRADICTIONS.label: Identify Contradictions
IDENTIFY_CONTRADICTIONS.instruction: Identify contradictions or tensions between the selected sources. For each contradiction, cite the conflicting source IDs and quote the relevant excerpt.

CREATE_CODEX_DIRECTIVE.label: Create Codex Directive
CREATE_CODEX_DIRECTIVE.instruction: Produce a directive suitable for OpenAI Codex, grounded strictly in the selected sources. State assumptions explicitly and mark anything not evidenced as UNKNOWN.

CREATE_CLAUDE_CODE_DIRECTIVE.label: Create Claude Code Directive
CREATE_CLAUDE_CODE_DIRECTIVE.instruction: Produce a directive suitable for Claude Code, grounded strictly in the selected sources. Include explicit truth requirements and known uncertainty.

CREATE_CHATGPT_DIRECTIVE.label: Create ChatGPT Directive
CREATE_CHATGPT_DIRECTIVE.instruction: Produce a directive suitable for ChatGPT, grounded strictly in the selected sources. Include explicit truth requirements and known uncertainty.

CREATE_LINKEDIN_COMMENT.label: Create LinkedIn Comment
CREATE_LINKEDIN_COMMENT.instruction: Draft a short LinkedIn comment responding to the selected source(s). Keep it grounded in what the source actually shows; do not fabricate claims of authorship or affiliation.

CREATE_LINKEDIN_POST.label: Create LinkedIn Post
CREATE_LINKEDIN_POST.instruction: Draft a LinkedIn post inspired by the selected sources. Clearly separate source-derived facts from the operator's own commentary.

CREATE_CINEMA_BRIEF.label: Create Cinema Brief
CREATE_CINEMA_BRIEF.instruction: Produce a cinema/video design brief grounded in the selected sources, covering only what the sources actually document (visual references, techniques, constraints).

CREATE_RPG_MECHANIC.label: Create RPG Mechanic
CREATE_RPG_MECHANIC.instruction: Propose an RPG mechanic inspired by the selected sources. Clearly distinguish mechanics evidenced in the sources from new design proposals (system inference).

CREATE_RESEARCH_QUESTIONS.label: Create Research Questions
CREATE_RESEARCH_QUESTIONS.instruction: Generate open research questions raised by the selected sources. Ground each question in a specific excerpt or gap.

CREATE_NOTEBOOKLM_SOURCE_BRIEF.label: Create NotebookLM Source Brief
CREATE_NOTEBOOKLM_SOURCE_BRIEF.instruction: Produce a source brief formatted for import into NotebookLM, listing each source with its excerpts and metadata.

CREATE_COMMERCIAL_PROOF_BRIEF.label: Create Commercial Proof Brief
CREATE_COMMERCIAL_PROOF_BRIEF.instruction: Produce a commercial proof brief grounded in the selected sources, distinguishing evidenced traction/validation from aspirational claims.

CREATE_CUSTOMER_DEMONSTRATION_BRIEF.label: Create Customer Demonstration Brief
CREATE_CUSTOMER_DEMONSTRATION_BRIEF.instruction: Produce a customer demonstration brief grounded in the selected sources, describing only capabilities the sources actually evidence.
